assistant|protein_suggestion_grilled_chi: Suggested grilled chicken breast marinated in favorite flavors, sliced over quinoa and roasted veggies.
assistant|protein_suggestion_salmon: Suggested pan-seared salmon seasoned with lemon juice, salt, and pepper for a healthy, omega-rich meal.
assistant|protein_suggestion_bolognese: Suggested lentil or mushroom bolognese cooked with onions, garlic, and tomatoes as a hearty plant-based protein.
assistant|protein_suggestion_turkey: Suggested roasted turkey breast seasoned with herbs and spices, sliced over quinoa and roasted veggies.
assistant|protein_suggestion_tofu: Suggested tofu marinated and baked or pan-fried, or crumbled into small pieces and mixed with quinoa and roasted veggies.
assistant|protein_suggestion_shrimp: Suggested shrimp quickly sautéed with garlic, lemon, and herbs, served over quinoa and roasted veggies.
assistant|protein_suggestion_chickpeas: Suggested chickpeas added to quinoa and roasted veggies for a plant-based protein boost, or a chickpea salad with tangy dressing.
assistant|protein_suggestion_steak: Suggested grilled steak sliced over quinoa and roasted veggies for a satisfying, protein-packed meal.
assistant|protein_suggestion_edamame: Suggested edamame boiled or steamed and seasoned with salt, pepper, and chili flakes.
assistant|protein_suggestion_tempeh: Suggested tempeh, a fermented soybean product, marinated and baked or pan-fried for a nutty, protein-rich option.
assistant|lentil_bolognese_servings: The lentil bolognese recipe yields 4-6 servings.
assistant|lentil_bolognese_cooking_time: The lentil bolognese recipe takes 30-40 minutes to cook.
assistant|lentil_bolognese_ingredients: Lentil bolognese ingredients: 1 cup dried green or brown lentils, 1 onion, 2 cloves garlic, 2 cups mixed mushrooms, 1 carrot, 1 celery stalk, 28 oz crushed tomatoes, 1 tsp dried basil, 1 tsp dried oregano, salt, pepper, and optional 1/4 cup red wine.
assistant|lentil_bolognese_method: Lentil bolognese method: sauté onion, garlic, carrot, and celery 5-7 minutes; add mushrooms and cook 5 minutes; add lentils, basil, and oregano 1-2 minutes; add crushed tomatoes, salt, pepper, and wine; simmer covered 20-25 minutes until lentils are tender.
assistant|lentil_bolognese_serving: Serve the lentil bolognese over quinoa, with roasted vegetables, or as a sauce for pasta or veggies.
assistant|lentil_bolognese_tips: Lentil bolognese tips: mix green, brown, and red lentils; add bay leaves, thyme, or rosemary; add 1-2 tbsp tomato paste; try porcini or cremini mushrooms; add bell peppers or zucchini during the last 10 minutes.
assistant|side_suggestion_roasted_brocco: Suggested roasted broccoli with garlic and lemon as a side for lentil bolognese and quinoa.
assistant|side_suggestion_brussels_sprou: Suggested Brussels sprouts with balsamic glaze and chopped nuts.
assistant|side_suggestion_sweet_potato_w: Suggested sweet potato wedges with rosemary and olive oil.
assistant|side_suggestion_carrots: Suggested roasted carrots with cumin and coriander.
assistant|side_suggestion_asparagus: Suggested asparagus with Parmesan cheese and lemon zest.
assistant|side_suggestion_spinach: Suggested sautéed spinach with garlic and lemon.
assistant|side_suggestion_kale: Suggested sautéed kale with cherry tomatoes and balsamic vinegar.
assistant|side_suggestion_collard_greens: Suggested sautéed collard greens with onions and smoked paprika.
assistant|add_in_pumpkin_seeds: Suggested toasted pumpkin seeds as a crunchy add-in for a nutty flavor.
assistant|add_in_herbs: Suggested chopped fresh parsley or cilantro as a crunchy add-in for a fresh burst.
assistant|add_in_red_pepper_flakes: Suggested crushed red pepper flakes as a crunchy add-in for a spicy kick.
assistant|add_in_nuts: Suggested sliced or chopped nuts (almonds, walnuts, or pecans) as a crunchy add-in.
assistant|add_in_parmesan: Suggested shaved Parmesan cheese for a salty, umami flavor.
assistant|add_in_feta: Suggested crumbly feta cheese for a tangy kick.
assistant|add_in_mozzarella: Suggested grated mozzarella or ricotta for a creamy addition.
assistant|add_in_bell_peppers: Suggested sliced or diced bell peppers for a pop of color and sweetness.
assistant|add_in_artichoke_hearts: Suggested artichoke hearts for a unique flavor and texture.
assistant|add_in_avocado: Suggested sliced or chopped avocado for a creamy, healthy fat boost.
assistant|meal_prep_tip_roasted_veggies: Advised preparing a batch of roasted vegetables on the weekend and storing them in the fridge for up to 5 days.
assistant|meal_prep_tip_quinoa: Advised cooking a large batch of quinoa and portioning it out for the week.
assistant|meal_prep_tip_freeze_bolognese: Advised making a double batch of lentil bolognese and freezing it for up to 3 months, then thawing and reheating as needed.
assistant|sweet_potato_seasoning_classic: Classic Herbs seasoning for roasted sweet potatoes: olive oil, salt, pepper, and chopped fresh rosemary, thyme, or sage; or dried oregano, basil, or parsley.
assistant|sweet_potato_seasoning_spicy: Spicy Kick seasoning for roasted sweet potatoes: olive oil, chili powder, cumin, and smoked paprika; add a pinch of cayenne or red pepper flakes.
assistant|sweet_potato_seasoning_mediter: Mediterranean seasoning for roasted sweet potatoes: olive oil, lemon juice, garlic powder, and dried oregano; add kalamata olives or artichoke hearts.
assistant|sweet_potato_seasoning_sweet_s: Sweet and Smoky seasoning for roasted sweet potatoes: olive oil, brown sugar, smoked paprika, and a pinch of cayenne; add chopped bacon or diced onions.
assistant|sweet_potato_seasoning_indian: Indian-Inspired seasoning for roasted sweet potatoes: olive oil, garam masala, cumin, and coriander; add chopped cilantro or scallions.
assistant|sweet_potato_seasoning_lemon_r: Lemon Rosemary seasoning for roasted sweet potatoes: olive oil, lemon zest, minced garlic, and chopped fresh rosemary; squeeze fresh lemon juice before serving.
assistant|sweet_potato_seasoning_simple: Simple Salt and Pepper seasoning for roasted sweet potatoes: olive oil, salt, and pepper.
assistant|sweet_potato_rosemary_recipe_i: Roasted sweet potatoes with fresh rosemary ingredients: 2-3 large sweet potatoes peeled and cubed, 2 tbsp olive oil, 2 sprigs fresh rosemary chopped (about 2 tbsp), and salt and pepper to taste.
assistant|sweet_potato_rosemary_recipe_m: Roasted sweet potatoes with fresh rosemary method: toss cubes with olive oil, chopped rosemary, salt, and pepper; roast at 425°F (220°C) for 20-25 minutes, flipping halfway, until tender and caramelized.
assistant|granola_sweetness: Advised reducing or omitting honey or maple syrup for a less sweet granola, or drizzling it on after cooling for a sweeter snack.
assistant|granola_spices: Suggested granola spices and flavorings: cinnamon, nutmeg, or cardamom; vanilla extract or vanilla bean; or a teaspoon of cocoa powder for a chocolatey twist.
assistant|granola_nuts_seeds: Suggested granola nuts and seeds: almonds, cashews, or hazelnuts; chia, flax, or hemp seeds; or peanut butter/another nut butter for creaminess.
assistant|granola_dried_fruits: Suggested granola dried fruits: cranberries, raisins, or cherries; apricots, apples, or pineapple; or omit dried fruits for a nutty, crunchy granola.
assistant|granola_grains: Suggested granola grain options: rolled oats, quinoa, or Kamut for a nutty, wholesome flavor; add puffed rice or wheat for a lighter, crunchier texture.
assistant|granola_other_mixins: Suggested other granola mix-ins: coconut flakes or shredded coconut; dark chocolate chips or M&M's; or cereal pieces like Cheerios or Cinnamon Toast Crunch.
assistant|add_in_fresh_herbs: Suggested chopped fresh herbs like basil, oregano, or thyme as an add-in for lentil bolognese and quinoa.
assistant|meal_prep_tip_greens_container: Advised prepping a container of sauteed greens or roasted vegetables to add to meal prep containers throughout the week.
assistant|sweet_potato_rosemary_variatio: Noted the rosemary amount can be adjusted to taste and other herbs like thyme or parsley can be added to the roasted sweet potatoes.
assistant|mix_and_match_advice: Repeatedly advised mixing and matching the suggested proteins, sides, seasonings, and granola mix-ins to find favorite combinations.
